jobs.description:
Position Overview

Harris Williams will not provide sponsorship for employment visas or participate in STEM OPT for this position.

Job Description
Location: Richmond, VA (in office)
We are a global investment bank specializing in M&A and private capital advisory services. Clients worldwide rely on us to help unlock value in their business and turn ambitious goals into reality. We approach every engagement with boundless collaboration, pooling expertise and relationships across industries, service offerings, and geographies. For over 35 years, our clients have trusted us to think strategically, execute precisely, and deliver premium outcomes to help them grow.

We are ambitious in our goals and steadfast in the belief that clients deserve our very best. To achieve our highest aspiration, we invest in world-class, team-oriented individuals who are smart, driven, and principled – those who are eager to be part of something bigger than themselves. When you join Harris Williams, you are welcomed into a collegial environment where every individual has the opportunity to make an impact in a powerful and significant way. We invite you to learn more about careers at Harris Williams.

The Role:
As Senior FP&A Analyst, you will sit at the intersection of strategy, finance, and firm leadership in a high visibility, high impact role. Beyond traditional reporting, you will serve as a strategic thought partner, translating complex financial data into insights that shape decision making across the Firm.

As a key contributor to our financial infrastructure, you will help connect long term strategic objectives with day to day operational execution. The role is ideal for a finance professional who combines analytical depth with strong business intuition and the ability to influence senior stakeholders through compelling financial storytelling.

Why This Role is Unique
The Senior FP&A Analyst is a critical partner to firm leadership, providing the financial insight needed to drive informed strategic and operational decisions. You will connect financial performance with business priorities, shaping resource allocation, investment decisions, and long range planning.

Through clear analysis, strong business partnership, and modern finance tools, including Power BI or Tableau and emerging AI enabled capabilities, you will help ensure Harris Williams operates with financial discipline, transparency, and agility as the Firm continues to grow. You will have direct exposure to senior leaders across Operations, Finance, IT, and Marketing, and real influence over how the Firm plans and invests.

Core Responsibilities:

Strategic Business Partnering
- Act as a trusted advisor to senior leaders and department heads across Operations, Finance, IT, and Marketing.
- Provide data driven insights and recommendations to support resource allocation, expense management, and headcount planning.
- Serve as a consultative partner, helping leaders understand the financial implications and trade offs tied to business decisions.

Advanced Financial Analysis and Performance Management
- Lead long term financial modeling, trend analysis, and assessments of macroeconomic impacts.
- Support monthly business reviews, delivering deep dive variance analyses focused on root cause identification and forward looking insights.
- Identify patterns and risks that inform both near term actions and longer term strategy.
- Support financial feasibility analysis and diligence for internal strategic initiatives.

Forecasting and Planning
- Lead revenue forecasting, monthly management reporting, and updates to long range financial plans.
- Develop and maintain scenario models to evaluate business risks, opportunities, and strategic trade offs.

Executive Reporting and Financial Storytelling
- Prepare high impact materials for executive leadership, including dashboards, commentary, and presentations.
- Translate complex financial results into clear, concise narratives that enable informed, timely decision making.

Digital Finance and Process Transformation
- Drive automation and modernization of FP&A processes, including the implementation of AI enabled tools and enhanced data workflows.
- Continuously improve Power BI or Tableau dashboards to provide real time visibility into firm performance.

Job Specific Competencies, Education and Experience :

Required
- Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field.
- 4+ years of progressive FP&A experience, ideally within investment banking, private equity, professional services, or another fast paced, high growth environment.
- Expert level Excel skills, with demonstrated experience building complex financial and scenario models.
- Proficiency with business intelligence tools.

Preferred
- CPA and/or a Master's degree, considered a differentiator for this senior level role.
- Tableau or Power BI experience.
- Experience working with modern ERP systems and a strong interest in leveraging AI and automation within finance workflows.

Competencies
- Analytical rigor: exceptional attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy and integrity.
- Executive presence: ability to confidently present financial insights and lead discussions with senior stakeholders.
- Business mindset: proactive, intellectually curious, and comfortable navigating ambiguity in a dynamic environment.
- Ownership and adaptability: self directed, accountable, and driven by continuous improvement.

Our Culture & Growth
When you join Harris Williams, you step into a highly collaborative, high-expectations environment where individuals are empowered to take ownership and make a visible impact. We value curiosity, accountability, and a strong team-first mindset.

This is an environment where you will be expected to lean in, contribute meaningfully, and grow quickly, working alongside passionate colleagues who are committed to excellence and continuous improvement.

Additional Information
- This is an in office role based in our Richmond, VA office.
- Candidates must be authorized to work in the U.S. without sponsorship
- This description reflects the core responsibilities of the role but is not intended to be all-inclusive. Responsibilities and focus areas may evolve based on business needs.

Financial Sponsor Coverage Associate Role
The Financial Sponsor Coverage ("FSC") Associate helps drive critical marketing content, firm insights, and analyses in support of the private equity ("PE") coverage efforts of FSC senior bankers and Coverage Officers across the firm. - Senior Banker Coordination — Serves as the primary point of coordination between the FSC Analyst(s)/SCCs and the FSC VP, Director, and MDs, keeping senior bankers apprised of deliverable status and surfacing insights and observations for broader firm distribution.

- FSC Reporting — Supports, develops, and owns FSC recurring reporting needs, including internal dashboards, and related standing deliverables.
- CRM and Data Services — Maintains a deep, current understanding of the firm's CRM and partners with HW data services and technology teams to shape new and improved reports, optimize reporting interfaces, and safeguard data integrity.
- Special Projects — Proactively identifies, pursues, and delivers value-adding projects in support of FSC strategy and broader firm needs, partnering closely with senior bankers, Analyst(s), and SCCs, as well as business operations and technology teams as needed.

- Experience — 2-4 years of experience in investment banking, private equity, or a related financial services role; prior exposure to sponsor/financial institutions coverage, origination, or deal teams is a plus.

In this position, you will partner closely with investment bankers, gaining exposure to live transactions while providing essential execution and administrative support. This role is ideal for someone who is proactive, detail-oriented, intellectually curious, and energized by working in a fast-paced, collaborative environment. This is an administrative and deal-coordination support role rather than an investment banking analyst position.

As an M&A Execution Assistant, you will sit at the center of live deal activity, working directly alongside investment bankers from kickoff through close. You will build organizational, communication, and deal-coordination skills inside a collegial, fast-moving team that values initiative and invests in your development.
